name: 夜读墨香
description: 温暖暗底 #1C1815 + 暖橘 #E08B6A + serif，弥补现有暗主题全是 coding 冷调的空缺。借鉴 github.com/GordenSun/WX Claude 主题的暗调变体：H1 居中下划、H2 左条、blockquote 左条柔橘、pre 深墨底。专为夜间深度阅读/长文沉浸设计。

styles.container: background-color: #1C1815; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #E08B6A; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #E08B6A; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #E6D9C4; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 4px solid #E08B6A; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC',serif;
styles.h3: font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #F0A888; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224,139,106,0.5);
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #E6D9C4; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid rgba(224,139,106,0.6);
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #C2B59E; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #8A7F6C; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #E6D9C4; line-height: 1.9; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #E08B6A; background: rgba(224,139,106,0.08); border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 15px; color: #C2B59E; line-height: 1.8;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #C2B59E; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; display: block; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 1px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#E08B6A,transparent);
styles.code: background: rgba(224,139,106,0.18); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 92%; color: #F0A888; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #0F0C08; border: 1px solid #3A3127; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #E6D9C4; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #2A2016; color: #C2B59E; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #E6D9C4; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #F0A888; background: rgba(224,139,106,0.12); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224,139,106,0.4);
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #E6D9C4; line-height: 1.9; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #8A7F6C; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
